CBlock_InsideBar_Long.name: InsideBar_Long
CBlock_InsideBar_Long.help: True when the current bar's high is below the previous bar's high AND the current bar's low is above the previous bar's low - i.e. the current bar is an Inside Bar, with the previous (mother) bar closing bullish.

CBlock_InsideBar_Short.name: InsideBar_Short
CBlock_InsideBar_Short.help: True when the current bar's high is below the previous bar's high AND the current bar's low is above the previous bar's low - i.e. the current bar is an Inside Bar, with the previous (mother) bar closing bearish.

CBlock_InsideBar_Any.name: InsideBar_Any
CBlock_InsideBar_Any.help: True when the current bar's high is below the previous bar's high AND the current bar's low is above the previous bar's low - i.e. the current bar's range is fully contained within the previous bar's range, regardless of the previous bar's direction.
